summary: Comprehensive test of the Free Pivot business change. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (subscriptions stubs, ownership stubs, payments stubs, catalog no-gate, 70/30 store split retained + math verified, rewards badge-only, removed band endpoints all 404). Frontend: Profile shows free-access-card + free-badge; go-pro-btn / pro-status-indicator / band-upload-tracker fully removed; PricingPage shows '100% Free. Forever.' heading, 8-item free-features-grid, artist-economy-card with '70% to the artist', join-free-btn navigates back to Profile; no forbidden strings (subscribe/upgrade/$79.98/$9.99/Pro/VIP) surfaced during navigation across Discover, Profile, Battle Stage, Learn; no console errors. Gamer lane toggle works and lands on Battle Stage; GamerPage source code inspected — pickTrack has NO ownership gate and footer hint reads 'Every track, every mode — 100% free' (the picker isn't directly reachable from bottom nav; the request noted 'if reachable'). Backstage/Learn navigation smoke-tested clean.
action_items: OPTIONAL: LiveChat.js lines 140-144 still contain conditional VIP badge styling (`msg.badge === 'VIP' ? orange : green`). Since the backend no longer emits VIP/PRO badges this is dead code, but if the goal was 'VIP/PRO badge logic removed' the conditional and the `{msg.badge}` render block should be deleted for full alignment with the free pivot.
critical_code_review_comments: GamerPage `case 'gamer'` in ViewRouter.js is not wired to any BottomNav item — only reachable via internal transitions. Consider either removing the case or hooking it up if the design intends a direct entry to the gamer track picker.
LiveChat.js still contains VIP badge branch (dead code) — remove for full free-pivot cleanup.
Backend `_track_in_curated_catalog` still computes hash gate; comment says 'informational only'. Fine to keep, but ensure no future callers gate on `in_catalog` when free-model is intended.
test_credentials: None — no auth in app; user ids are localStorage UUIDs
seed_data_creation: Test purchases created under `TEST_` prefix in `song_purchases` collection (idempotency test). Not cleaned up automatically — safe because prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Free-pivot backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_free_pivot.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. All 16 tests pass. Frontend flows verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844). The Gamer picker (GamerPage with gamer-search-input) is not directly reachable via bottom nav; code was inspected instead to confirm pickTrack has no ownership gate.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. All acceptance criteria in the review request are satisfied.
